entities.name: FMO3 bovine
observations: The 532-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8HYJ9, flavin-containing monooxygenase 3 from Bos taurus.
FMO3 is an FAD-dependent monooxygenase that oxygenates nitrogen- and sulfur-containing compounds, including trimethylamine, drugs, and dietary metabolites.
Reference annotations assign endoplasmic-reticulum/microsomal membrane localization and a single C-terminal transmembrane helix around residues 510-530.

Candidate reactions include trimethylamine to trimethylamine N-oxide, albendazole to albendazole sulfoxide, N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide formation, hypotaurine to taurine, and nicotine N-oxide formation.
The sequence contains a strong FMO-like domain spanning approximately residues 3-530; Pfam evidence also supports pyridine-nucleotide redox/NAD-binding features.
Reference annotations identify FAD and NADP binding and EC classes 1.14.13.148, 1.14.13.32, and 1.14.13.8.

The protein is implicated in hepatic xenobiotic and metabolite oxidation; trimethylamine oxidation regulates trimethylamine N-oxide levels and can influence platelet responsiveness and thrombus formation.
